headline: Backup Power Outlook for Travis County
summary: Homes in Travis County face a long outage about once every 11 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In February 2021, 43% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 74 hours. In February 2023, 29% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 106 hours. One Core lasts about 14 hours in August. One Core lasts about 30 hours in February. Two Cores are suggested for a home with gas heat and a larger footprint. Two Cores cover 78% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
